It’s a beautiful trail, and quite beginners friendly! The flowers and butterflies of May will inspire your inner child as you make your way through the rocky hills. There’s a resting spot where you can sit on the ridge way, the sound of the water running through the creek and the quietude of the surrounding forest will give you much sense of peace. It’s the perfect place for a little meditation in the middle of your hike. The trail attracts the most polite enthusiasts too, who won’t hesitate to encourage you with a friendly salute as you make your way through the trees. This is also the habitat to some endangered species, so you have to be mindful if you encounter them. There’s a few snakes along your path, so that’s also something to be cautious about, but as long as you don’t bother them, they will leave you alone. It’s recomendable to go with a companion if you’re new to these adventures in case of injury. The dogsledge is probably the easiest pathway as well. You can hear the sounds of traffic near the entrances but if you dive deeper into the trail, once you cross the small wooden bridge, you should find yourself in the serenity of nature. 

It’s a beautiful hidden gem, and I hope you have the chance to explore it and experience the refreshing quality of its air.
